A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to create matching denominators before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that add one whole as n/n after denominators are already established.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/b to align with a mixed-number or fraction subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary decomposition of an already standard mixed number into whole and fraction parts unless a new equivalent form is created.
Do not tag denominator conversion for unlike fractions; that belongs to matching denominators.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including direct numerator subtraction for pure fractions or fraction parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of same-denominator fractions.
Tag when the solution subtracts fraction parts of mixed numbers after denominators are already matched.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates common denominators.
Do not tag whole-number subtraction by itself.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components in a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly computes the difference of whole parts.
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is treated as the whole-part component of a mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number components.
Do not tag the later borrowing adjustment step; that belongs to regrouping.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole and convert it to fractional units when the fraction part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fraction part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution shows a negative fraction part and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when one whole is converted to b/b or an equivalent fractional amount and added to the minuend fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without borrowing.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/b unless a later borrow/regroup actually occurs.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or simplify a zero-fraction or mixed-number expression to an integer or simpler form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor.
Tag when 0/b is simplified to 0 or a mixed number with zero fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely writing the final answer if no reduction or simplification occurs.
Do not tag combining a nonzero whole and fraction part into a mixed number unless simplification is also performed.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole-part and fraction-part results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a fraction only, or when whole and zero-fraction parts are combined into an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag isolated subtraction steps that have not yet been recombined.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction by common factors unless the step also explicitly combines parts into final form.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to create matching denominators before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that add one whole as n/n after denominators are already established.

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fraction parts to prepare for separate subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for merely identifying a problem type without rewriting any quantity.
Do not tag when the numbers are already in directly usable form and no representation change occurs.
Do not tag for combining final whole and fraction results.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separately subtracts whole parts and fraction parts after setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or converting fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears.
Do not tag for simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup by taking 1 from the whole-number part and converting it to a fraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a negative fractional result triggers borrowing from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted to n/n and added to the existing fractional part before subtracting.
Tag when the whole part is reduced by 1 to support fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0/n unless an actual borrow/regroup step occurs.
Do not tag for simplification after regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by common factors.
Tag when a result like 0/3 or 1 0/3 is simplified to 0 or 1.
Tag when the final numeric form is changed to a simpler equivalent form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term nonzero fraction with no simplification shown.
Do not tag for merely writing the final answer if no reduction or simplification occurs.
Do not tag for combining whole and fraction parts unless a simplification is explicitly performed.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into a single final mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the final answer is expressed as a mixed number or integer after prior computations.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for simplification alone if no recombination of parts occurs.
Do not tag when the result is already a single fraction from direct subtraction of pure fractions.
Do not tag for setup rewrites such as decomposing a mixed number into whole and fraction parts.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that add one whole as n/n without first solving an unlike-denominator issue.
Do not tag mere problem classification statements with no denominator work.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to align with a mixed-number or fraction subtraction setup.
Tag when the solution explicitly decomposes a mixed number into whole and fractional parts for computation.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag the final recombination of whole and fraction parts into the answer.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after any needed setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part to the fraction part.
Tag when 1 is rewritten as n/n and added to the minuend fraction before subtracting.
Tag in whole-minus-fraction or mixed-minus-mixed problems where regrouping resolves a negative fractional result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fraction part is already large enough and no regrouping occurs.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag final combination or simplification after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction/whole-valued result to its simplest form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/n is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed-number or fractional expression is rewritten as an integer because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag the mere act of writing the final answer if no reduction or simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly states the combined final value after prior computations.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts before the final assembly.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly combine parts into the final form.
Do not tag setup/rewriting steps that separate parts rather than combine them.
